summary: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A., a Luxembourg-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K containing only its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, signed by CFO Marcus Arildsson. The filing, incorporated by reference into its Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements, is a routine periodic earnings disclosure with no transactional event, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no deal terms. No special-situation angle applies; monitor ordinary operating results and liquidity only.
